description: This file defines classes and structures for managing uplink PDU (Protocol Data Unit) repositories in a 5G NR (New Radio) physical layer implementation. It includes classes for registering, managing, and scope-limiting uplink PDUs such as PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS, with mechanisms for resource management and scope-based lifetime control.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository
classes.description: Abstract base class for registering PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS PDUs within a slot context.

classes.name: unique_uplink_pdu_slot_repository
classes.description: Manages a scope-limited, unique instance of an uplink PDU repository, ensuring proper resource finalization.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository_callback
classes.description: Callback interface for the underlying uplink PDU repository, including a method to finish adding PDUs.

classes.name: uplink_pdu_slot_repository_pool
classes.description: Interface for a pool managing multiple uplink PDU slot repositories.

methods.name: add_pusch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUSCH PDU to the repository.

methods.name: add_pucch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH PDU to the repository.

methods.name: add_srs_pdu
methods.description: Adds an SRS PDU to the repository.

methods.name: finish_adding_pdus
methods.description: Signals that no more PDUs will be added and returns the resource grid.

methods.name: get_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Retrieves the PDU slot repository for a specific slot.
